gen-gf-gabarito-gf-rhodium-libre: Rhodium Libre leans editorial, its brush-lifted stroke ends feeling traditional. Gabarito's pen-steady drawing is the pair's best quality, a display heading that holds firm over that softer text serif.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-rokkitt: Gabarito's open-cut terminals and nib-drawn look make it the unmistakable voice up top. And Rokkitt, a classic serif with a c bent like a paperclip, offers the bookish, low-slung comfort below.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-sanchez: Gabarito turns its o into a ring with a constant wall, loud and expressive across the heading line. Sanchez, a dignified serif, handles the quieter work.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-solway: Distinctive in the heading, Gabarito flows its terminals open like a single nib's work. And Solway, a classic serif with flat, stencil-like strokes, gives that expressive display a bookish, authoritative footing.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-yuji-boku: Gabarito's terminals are cut open so its counters flow outward, giving the heading a nib-drawn voice. And Yuji Boku, a dignified serif with cable-like strokes, steadies the text below it.
gen-gf-gabarito-nunito-sans: Loose, expressive curves and open terminals define Gabarito, with its curves and straights sharing one width above Nunito Sans. Soft and friendly, they sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-rowan: Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like letters wide and bold across the heading line. And Rowan, a literary text serif with friendly openings in every curve, brings a gentler texture beneath.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-almendra: Commanding in the heading, Goldman spaces its big-lowercase letters generously and lets round forms open like parentheses. Almendra, a bookish serif, adds a deep-bellied dignity.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-bree-serif: Bold from the first word, Goldman sets wide, round letters with a tall lowercase. Bree Serif, with its outsized lowercase, keeps a long stretch of text feeling literary and refined.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-quando: Quando brings a bookish, traditional text serif with sparse spacing and a tall middle zone in every word. Goldman, wide and bold with parenthesis-like round forms, stands over Quando with plenty of command.
